notes: Sources: pinned posteriordb Stan nn_rbm1bJ100.stan and the assigned native models/posteriordb_nn_rbm1bJ100_*.py builder(s). Original constrained parameter shapes/index order are preserved unless explicitly mapped below; automatic support-transform Jacobians are disabled in both engines.

Identity of alpha (M,J), beta (J,K-1), row-vector alpha1 (J,), beta1 (K-1,) and their variances. No transpose or Fortran/C flattening permutation is applied to matrices. The hidden layer is tanh(x@alpha+alpha1), and nonbaseline logits are hidden@beta+beta1. The first category logit is one, not zero; observed labels shift from 1..K to 0..K-1.
The variance priors have inverse-gamma shape 0.25 and scales 0.25*(0.05/M^2)^2 and 0.25*(0.05/J^2)^2. Conditional weight SDs are square roots of these variances, matching the original priors.
